description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the TimesheetActionLogAPI within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It tests API endpoints related to timesheet action logs, including retrieval, creation, and deletion, primarily focusing on the 'getAll' functionality and ensuring that other methods throw not implemented exceptions.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLogAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the TimesheetActionLogAPI, testing the 'getAll' API method and verifying that create, delete, and related validation rules are not implemented.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initial setup before each test, clearing the entity manager.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all timesheet action logs via the API, using data providers for multiple test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides a list of test cases (e.g., YAML-defined) for testing the 'getAll' API endpoint.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the create method throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule for create is not implemented and throws accordingly.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the delete method throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule for delete is not implemented and throws accordingly.
